text:
Sam: Quick spike summary — proposing we extract the telemetry/ingest hotpath out of the gateway into an ingest-sidecar service. TL;DR: moves CPU + KV churn off hotpath, lets us scale independently. Sketch + open Qs below, PTAL @Maya @Ben :eyes:

Ben: Sounds reasonable. main worry is shared state — session lookups + transient counters. how do we keep consistency during cutover?

Maya: Also want to see traffic shape impact on batching and KV cache behavior. if we mis-handle ordering we could regress 95p latency.

Sam: Agree. thinking: sidecar owns prefix/KV cache and emits canonical events to new ingest topic. gateway will route writes to both (shadow) then flip read path once warm.

Olga: Shadow + flip makes sense. rollback plan? if we start to see errors on reads we need instant fallback to gateway-local path. propose feature-flag switch + circuit-breaker around sidecar reads.

Ben: API contract needs to be explicit. define stable protobuf for ingest.v1 and include version header. sidecar should accept v1 and v1-compat requests for X weeks.

Sam: rough rollout plan draft: 1) shadow 100% writes to sidecar (no reads) for 1 sprint; 2) canary reads 1%/5%/25%/100% with perf checks; 3) cut reads when cache-warmth & 95p lat < baseline + 10ms.

Maya: Test harness requirements: perf runner that replays production traces, kv-cache instrumentation, and end-to-end assertions for ordering. I can sketch jobs.

Sam: feature flag example (proto):
```json
{
  "feature": "ingest_sidecar_reads",
  "rollout": {
    "percent": 1,
    "stages": [1,5,25,100],
    "owners": ["sam","ben"]
  }
}
```

Ben: Data migration: for transient counters we can rebuild from event stream; for authoritative session state we need a live-copy phase then cutover. I'll own migration tooling.

Olga: Observability checklist: 95p latency, token-level CPU, sidecar RTX util, duplicate-event rate, cache-hit ratio, end-to-end SLO. add a "panic" metric that trips if duplicate-event-rate > 1% or 95p latency > baseline+50ms.

Sam: Good. add an "observation kill switch" env var that the rollout infra can flip immediately. and a circuit breaker back to gateway on >10% error rate for >1m.

Maya: Local dev command to run perf harness (WIP):
```bash
# replay last-hour trace against sidecar locally
docker-compose up --build perf-runner
./perf-runner --trace last_hour.json --target http://localhost:8081 --rate 200
```

arch-bot: RFC doc updated: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/ingest-sidecar (last edited by Sam).

Ben: We also need to think about reserved capacity for Dedicated customers — sidecar autoscaling and burst configs should be part of the RFC. otherwise cost profiles change.

Olga: Agree. include billing impact estimate and ops runbook steps for when Dedicated pools saturate.

Maya: I'll add perf guardrails to the Optimize checklist (quantization / batch sizing suggestions) so we don't regress tokens/sec.

Sam: Next steps: I'll open the RFC with the draft rollout plan, link migration-ticket #T-4219, assign Ben for migration, Maya for perf harness, Olga for runbook/rollback. pls review in the RFC thread by EOW. thanks :pray:
